verification_note: Three faults each in the small mixed GKR/PCS fixture and the original reduced Gemma caller. Native candidates equal CPU reference wire, FS digest and original MAC obligations before continuing through original verifier/PCS methods; no replacement acceptance. The reduced caller keeps statistics, P0, local V, RNE, original W/A roots and compiled tile support. Native prefix retires all651 allocations per caller trial. Correlations are ideal test rows; no real AES setup/session, original model weights/inputs, canonical response/acceptance journal, mixed159-program GPU moments, full tail/core backend or complete simultaneous capacity. No timing extrapolation from reduced tests. CPU wrapper AS64GiB; CUDA child AS unlimited, sampled physical/deadline stops unchanged. CUDA binary reused from clean88a08c6d with exact hash and unchanged CUDA/driver sources. GPU idle before and after; observed samples do not establish instantaneous peak or allowance.
